name: Dornier 328
summary: A 30-seat regional airliner built in turboprop and 'JET' versions; most US-registered examples are the 328JET, flown by small airlines and charter operators.

wings: High, straight wing with tapered tips
328JET carries underwing turbofan pods; the turboprop has nacelles on the wing
engines: Two turboprops on the wing (PW119B) or two turbofans in underwing pods (328JET)
fuselage: Short, stubby fuselage with a rounded nose
tail: T-tail with a tall swept fin

tellTales: High wing, T-tail and a short, stubby fuselage
Turboprops on the wings, or small turbofan pods under a high wing
Rounded nose and upswept tail cone

confusedWith.howToTell: The ATR 42/72 has a longer, larger fuselage with a longer wing; the Dornier 328 is shorter and stubbier.
The 1900 has a low-mounted wing and a different tail; the Dornier 328 has a high wing and a T-tail.
The ERJ145 has a low wing and rear-mounted engines; the Dornier 328JET has a high wing and underwing engines.
The BAe 146 has four engines on a high wing; the Dornier 328 has two engines.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
